name: US–China / Taiwan
value: No major PLA exercise since Dec 2025
summary: Routine PLA activity; leaders' dialogue continues ahead of APEC
state: Beijing has held no large-scale exercise around Taiwan since December 2025; the Liaoning carrier group drilled in the Philippine Sea on 14–15 Oct before heading to the South China Sea (USNI). Taiwan says it is watching for larger drills as the season peaks. No new exercise had been reported as of 1 Nov.
for_you: No acute Taiwan Strait crisis is under way. Watch for a sudden 'snap' exercise, which Beijing used in December 2025.
rubric_hit: Managed relations; dialogue channels open; routine PLA activity.

why: The world's two largest economies; a Taiwan crisis would halt most advanced chip supply and risk great-power war.
